title: "Research Themes and Experiment Ledger"

::: {.lead}
The project currently uses **Qwen3.5-4B with 12 uniform frames** as its visual
baseline and adds specialist evidence only through declared, quality-gated
routes. Frozen-30 protocol v2 is the strongest matched comparison; the smaller
panels are diagnostics. A result that missed one promotion gate is not a
permanent verdict on every model, prompt, selector, budget, or panel.
:::

Use [Start Here · Report page](index.{{< meta report-ext >}}) for the current operational
recommendation and the [Code Map · Report page](code-map.{{< meta report-ext >}}) to find the
implementation boundary. The six themes below are independent research areas,
not a sequence.

## Six-theme research map

:::: {.theme-grid}
::: {.theme-card}
### [Experiment integrity and evaluation](research-integrity.{{< meta report-ext >}})

**Working answer:** frozen-30 protocol v2 is interpretable; successful
execution alone does not establish answer quality.

**Strongest evidence:** verified 30-row, four-arm protocol v2 plus integrity
audits.

**Open question:** can one reusable gate reject label, identity, mutation, and
scoring-boundary faults before an expensive run?
:::

::: {.theme-card}
### [Visual and temporal evidence](research-visual-evidence.{{< meta report-ext >}})

**Working answer:** uniform-12 remains the default; global 24 frames and the
tested directed/burst heuristics were not promoted under their tested
conditions.

**Strongest evidence:** matched frozen-30 frame-budget comparison; smaller
10-row and 2-row temporal diagnostics.

**Open question:** can a fixed-budget selector retrieve the required moment
more reliably than uniform sampling?
:::

::: {.theme-card}
### [Speech and transcript evidence](research-speech-transcripts.{{< meta report-ext >}})

**Working answer:** route quality-accepted Whisper to lexical speech; keep
transcript provenance explicit and the independent human tier blocked.

**Strongest evidence:** selected 10-row automatic-transcript ablation plus
frozen-30 transcript results.

**Open question:** do grounded spans, alternative ASR, or a valid human upper
bound improve answers without hiding transcript errors?
:::

::: {.theme-card}
### [Native audio and sound](research-native-audio.{{< meta report-ext >}})

**Working answer:** native audio is not a global switch; prosody and non-speech
sound remain routed candidates.

**Strongest evidence:** matched audio-on/off and failure-selected diagnostics,
not a representative benchmark.

**Open question:** which declared audio strata improve without regressing
visual controls?
:::

::: {.theme-card}
### [Models and adaptation](research-models.{{< meta report-ext >}})

**Working answer:** no later candidate has displaced Qwen3.5-4B; MiniCPM-o
audio-off is the fast alternate.

**Strongest evidence:** frozen-30 model comparison; later model screens are
selected diagnostics or compatibility checks.

**Open question:** can a repaired, complete candidate pass a matched quality
and integrity gate?
:::

::: {.theme-card}
### [Routing, fusion, and answer selection](research-routing.{{< meta report-ext >}})

**Working answer:** use the baseline unless a label-blind specialist rule
applies; the repository has route seeds, not a validated router.

**Strongest evidence:** taxonomy and residual-error diagnostics.

**Open question:** is each failure missing evidence, unused evidence, or wrong
answer selection—and can a router abstain without regressions?
:::
::::

## Branch-complete next-test queue

These branches are independent choices; their numbering is for reference, not
a prescribed research sequence.

1. **Smarter visual sampling/retrieval:** [label required moments and compare
   fixed-budget selectors](research-visual-evidence.{{< meta report-ext >}}#required-moments-selector-recall-and-oracle-frames).
2. **Alternative ASR:** [compare an alternative or multilingual ASR on one
   frozen, source-language-aware panel](research-speech-transcripts.{{< meta report-ext >}}#alternative-or-multilingual-asr-matched-panel).
3. **Human/reference transcript controls:** [produce an independently reviewed,
   label-blind upper bound](research-speech-transcripts.{{< meta report-ext >}}#label-blind-human-transcript-upper-bound).
4. **Routed native audio/sound:** [test prosody and non-speech strata with
   abstention and matched controls](research-native-audio.{{< meta report-ext >}}#matched-native-audio-specialist-panel).
5. **Repaired/specialist models or bottleneck-first adaptation:** [repair the
   strict Omni path](research-models.{{< meta report-ext >}}#repaired-complete-neutral-qwen3-omni-run), or [measure the bottleneck before adapting](research-models.{{< meta report-ext >}}#bottleneck-first-adaptation-decision).
6. **Routing, fusion, and answer election:** [measure retrieval, oracle-evidence
   answering, and end-to-end answering separately](research-routing.{{< meta report-ext >}}#required-evidence-labels-and-three-way-measurement), then test election only if evidence paths are stable.

## How to interpret results

These status labels describe the evidence available now, not permanent
properties of a technique:

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Current default** | Strongest available evidence for present use. |
| **Fast alternate** | Explicit cost or latency trade-off, not an accuracy claim on every metric. |
| **Routed candidate** | Consider only for a declared question or evidence type. |
| **Diagnostic signal** | Chooses the next test; does not estimate prevalence or general quality. |
| **Not promoted under the tested condition** | This implementation, panel, budget, or gate did not justify promotion; another controlled condition remains possible. |
| **Blocked** | A named prerequisite is absent, so the experiment cannot yet run or be interpreted validly. |
| **Superseded** | Later valid evidence replaces the earlier conclusion. |
| **Open hypothesis** | Proposed but not yet tested. |

Validity concerns are separate from result status:

- **Confirmed defect — demonstrated fault.** Frozen-30 v1 could not demonstrate
  label isolation, so v1 cannot support the comparative conclusion.
- **Audit gap — exact path is not proven by tracked evidence.** The directed
  selector has source and tests but no tracked general-workflow caller; that is
  not proof that the diagnostic run was buggy.
- **Uncertainty — limited generalization without bug evidence.** Small or
  selected diagnostic panels constrain what can be claimed, even when the run
  itself is clean.

## What superseded what {#what-superseded-what}

Six records explain which later evidence replaced an earlier project statement.

<details>
<summary>Expand six supersession records</summary>

| Earlier statement or result | Superseding evidence | Current interpretation |
|---|---|---|
| July 12 architecture priorities | Executed panels through July 25 | Background field guide only; use this hub and its theme pages for current status. |
| Failure panel favored global Qwen24 | Frozen-30 protocol v2 | Qwen12 is the global default; global 24 frames added no exact answers under the tested condition. |
| Whisper as a broad additional modality | Frozen-30 plus automatic-transcript ablation | Route quality-gated Whisper only to lexical-speech work. |
| Initial Gemma compatibility promotion | Phi/Gemma semantic gate | Gemma and Phi were not promoted beyond the tested three-row semantic screen; compatibility is not quality. |
| Qwen3-Omni compatibility success | Neutral quality-10 A2 | The strict run is ineligible for its predeclared promotion decision after 19/20 outputs; the model remains eligible for a repaired fresh comparison. |
| Directed and dense temporal heuristics | Their matched diagnostic panels | The tested implementations were not promoted; smarter fixed-budget sampling remains an open hypothesis. |

</details>
